newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares quieter but index gains further.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares quieter but index gains further.

text.p: Shares on the Tallinn stock exchange saw a quieter day on Tuesday after the previous day's hectic activity but the Estonian index still managed to climb higher, dealers said.
Overall turnover on the official list was 7.5 million kroons after more than 11 million kroons on Monday and the index rose 0.58 percent to 104.8.
Shares in Forexbank were the most active on the main list and it turned over slightly more than two million kroons and ended at 78.30 kroons versus 78.95.
It earlier announced a nine-month profit of 29.4 million kroons but dealers said this had little effect on the shares.
The volume on the free market, the exchange's over-the-counter market, was 6.1 million kroons and shares in meat processor Rakvere were again the most popular.
It traded 2.6 million kroons of shares and ended at 5.20 kroons after 4.60 kroons.
